title: E-Commerce Executive
description:
E-commerce Executive

Cannock

30,000 plus bonus

My well-established Cannock based client is recruiting for an E-Commerce Executive to join its busy team. The role supports the smooth day-to-day running of the e-commerce channel by maintaining systems, assisting with incoming customer and order administration, and enabling the e-commerce Account Manager to focus on account growth and strategic priorities.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support to the e-commerce function, including managing customer enquiries, and maintaining accurate customer records via CRM system and producing daily reports.
- Assist with the coordination and processing of e-commerce orders, ensuring timely handling and a high standard of customer service.
- Support the Ecommerce Account Manager with quotations by providing excellent customer communication.
- Maintain accurate product listings, pricing, and stock information across e-commerce platforms.
- Monitor order and sales data, identifying inconsistencies, errors, or opportunities for process improvement.
- Help ensure pricing accuracy and support basic margin tracking by flagging discrepancies or concerns.
- Support the upkeep and organisation of customer and sales data to ensure consistency across systems.
- Assist in improving administrative processes across the end-to-end e-commerce journey, from enquiry through to fulfilment.
- Liaise with internal departments such as purchasing, marketing, and customer service to ensure the smooth processing of orders and resolution of queries.
- Provide day to day administrative support to the e-commerce Manager

Essential Skills and Experience
- Previous experience in a Sales / Sales administration or support role
- Professional and confident telephone manner
- High level IT Skills
- Ability to deal with a high-volume product base
- Organised with an eye for details
- Able to work in a faced paced and targeted environment

To apply for this role please contact Sarah Dyehouse at Anderson Scott

title: Marketing Manager
description:
- Marketing Manager
- Tamworth, Staffordshire (Hybrid-Working)
- c£50,000 per year
- Plus excellent company benefits (28 days holiday + Bank holidays, Pension, Healthcare, etc.

The Opportunity:

My client based in the renewables sector are looking for a Marketing Manager on a permanent basis to be responsible for developing and delivering the marketing strategy and associated marketing activities that promote the organisation's products, services, events and brand.

The role drives market awareness, customer engagement and business growth through targeted campaigns, digital marketing, content, social media and lead generation initiatives.

A key focus of the role is to increase the volume and quality of leads, expand and nurture the customer database and optimise the use of HubSpot as the organisation's CRM and marketing automation platform.

Skills and Experience:
- Strong HubSpot experience essential
- You must be able to drive their marketing van to sites for events and shows
- Relevant tech/engineering/agriculture industry experience is essential
- Adept in marketing planning and managing social media across a variety of channels.
- Experience of communicating credibly at senior levels and supervising a small team
- Direct line management of Graphic Designer and sales and marketing co-ordinator
- Develop and execute the strategic marketing plan and keeping the CCO and CEO informed of progress, outcomes and activities.
- Communicate with CCO, Sales team, product team and the senior leadership team about existing and new marketing activities as a part of monthly reporting and measurement presentations.
- Increase customer acquisition via web, CRM and social media, ensure HubSpot is accurately updated and fully utilised. Using your HUBSPOT expertise, you will work closely with the entire business to deliver a new integrated marketing platform for the business with a focus on Campaign Automation, Lead Generation, CRM Management and Analytics and reporting.
- Organising promotional events such as trade shows and ensuring the prompt delivery of materials and products by coordinating with employees, internal and external stakeholders
- Manage and create appropriate content for a variety of social media channels.
- Manage go to market for new product launches.

Applications:

To learn more about our client and this great opportunity on offer working as a Marketing Manager based in Tamworth, Staffordshire; please call and speak with John Noonan here at ISR Recruitment or please email me a copy of your very latest CV and I ll call you back to discuss the role in more detail.

Please contact John Noonan here at ISR to learn more about our exciting client and how they are developing the IT services and systems across the renewable energy sector that make them a leader in their respective field?
